description: Code-behind for StartExam.aspx page handling exam selection, course loading based on user session, and navigation in an online examination system.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for StartExam.aspx managing exam start logic, course list population, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, populates course dropdown based on user semester, and manages user session validation.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates exam based on selected type and course, checks question availability, and sets session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exam, checks if already taken, and prepares for exam start.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exam, checks if already taken, and prepares for exam start.
